Our Mission
"Increasing Japan's GDP and creating a society where people believe tomorrow will be a better day."
Japan's labor productivity remains low among developed nations, with both GDP and real wages continuing to decline. To break through this stagnation, Meetsmore works to improve productivity in the service industry.
We do this through "Meetsmore," a platform automating customer acquisition and estimating; "ProOne," a SaaS streamlining all business operations for service providers; and "Hatch-u," an ordering and receiving DX service combining ProOne's infrastructure with the network of professionals on Meetsmore.
Though our users are rapidly increasing, we're only at the first step toward our goal. Because it's an incredibly high mountain to climb, we want to scale it with colleagues who share our vision and can face our users and products head-on. Join us in realizing a world where people believe tomorrow will surely be a better day, through world-class services.

jobContent:
【言語要件に関する重要事項】
本ポジションは英語で業務遂行が可能な方を対象としています。
社内コミュニケーションは主に英語（一部日本語・翻訳ツール併用）で、選考プロセスもコホン英語で実施します。
日本語は日常会話レベル、または学習意欲があれば応募可能です。
■仕事についての詳細
About the position
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is passionate about building reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems — from backend business logic to frontend user experiences.
You'll work primarily with TypeScript, with React
Next.js on the frontend and NestJS
Prisma on the backend. You'll collaborate closely with both engineers and non-engineers (product, design, biz/ops) to ship features that power the core of our product for some of Japan's largest enterprise customers.
Our Tech Stack
Not exhaustive, but the most important are:
TypeScript everywhere;
Node.js;
NestJS
Prisma
PostgreSQL on the backend;
React
Next.js on the frontend, React Native (Expo) on mobile; and
AWS (EKS, S3, Lambda); and
Redis.
Responsibilities
Design and deliver features end-to-end across the stack (frontend, backend, architecture).
Take ownership of technically challenging projects, such as refactoring, complex data modeling, or new platform integrations.
Drive improvements in system reliability, performance, and maintainability.
Mentor other engineers and champion high standards in code quality and architecture.
Participate in support rotations to investigate bugs and incidents.
We value engineers who care deeply about technical quality, end-user experience, and long-term stability — not just shipping tickets fast.
How we use AI in development
We are bullish on AI as a development tool, and provide free usage of AI tools like Claude Code for our engineers. We have an internal AI task force responsible for policy, guidelines, oversight, and technology in order to empower our engineers to use AI safely and efficiently.
Requirements
7+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Significant experience with TypeScript.
2+ years of hands-on work with React (or a similar modern frontend framework).
Strong understanding of backend frameworks, database modeling (SQL/Prisma), and asynchronous app architecture.
Proficiency collaborating across functions (product, design, operations, and stakeholders).
Track record of delivering production systems with an emphasis on scalability, reliability, testability, and maintainability.
Familiarity with modern development workflows: Git, PR reviews, CI/CD, and automated testing.
Be located in, or be willing to relocate to, Japan (we will support relocation).
Nice to haves
While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following.
Experience with our specific stack: NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, AWS.
Development and operation using containers (e.g. Docker).
Cloud infrastructure experience (e.g. AWS or GCP).
Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor).
Experience building B2B or enterprise SaaS products.
Conversational-level Japanese.
What makes this role compelling
A diverse team of strong engineers. Engineers from 12+ countries bring diverse perspectives and skills.
High-growth, real-world impact. ProOne is a vertical SaaS product developed by Meetsmore growing rapidly in Japan's service industry. Your work directly impacts how thousands of businesses operate daily.
